{{Top|leg}}
During the [[Mission to Tazan]], '''"Hamzad Clines"''' was an alias used by a [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to contact the Rebel sympathizer [[Willer Clines]] at his [[Willer Clines' House|home]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tazan]]. As part of the cover story, "Hamzad Clines" had lived on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], but was not there when it was [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] by the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], and was looking for any relatives that had escaped the destruction as well.<ref name="UCD">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=rpga/articles/rx20010816s|text=Ultimate Core Dump|int=Ultimate Core Dump}}</ref>
